raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

GPT-OSS uses equal D64 Q/K and V heads with learned scalar attention sinks. With FIA enabled, prefill currently selects the BSND fallback because D64 is outside the general TND whitelist. That fallback omits `learnable_sink`; for full-attention layers it also passes `pre_tokens=-1`, which FIA rejects. The eager decode branch also passes learned sinks through BSND; it needs the TND sink layout and its cumulative query-length contract.

Fixes #44025.

## Modifications

Route equal D64 prefill attention with sinks through the existing TND sink branch. For eager decode with learned sinks, use contiguous packed TND queries, cumulative one-query sequence lengths, the matching causal/sliding mask, and the full-attention window value.

Add a registered NPU server regression using the genuine pretrained BF16 GPT-OSS-20B checkpoint, with prompts below and above the sliding-window length. Each prompt must generate more than one token, exercising eager decode as well as prefill. The test also checks prompt token counts and finite output token log probabilities. It is registered in `base-b-test-1-npu-a3`.

This change covers prefill and eager decode with learned sinks. The graph replay work in #33635 is separate.

## Accuracy Tests

Environment: Ascend 910_9382 (single A3); CANN 9.0.0; Python 3.11.15; torch 2.10.0+cpu with torch-npu 2.10.0; triton-ascend 3.2.1.dev20260530; Transformers 5.19.0; sgl-kernel-npu 2026.5.1 with an isolated, reviewed SwiGLU-OAI source overlay (not the unmodified stock package)..

Checkpoint: [`unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-BF16`](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-BF16/tree/5a6fe4c0c1a86147cb9dc1bb99486e61d12a3c9e), pinned revision `5a6fe4c0c1a86147cb9dc1bb99486e61d12a3c9e`, with its original 24-layer configuration and weights. Single NPU, TP=1, BF16, Q64/KV8/D64, page size 128, FIA enabled, and both graph backends disabled.

Validation required the independent SwiGLU-OAI UB-capacity fix in https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-kernel-npu/pull/857. The original FIA source, patched FIA source, and registered test all used the same isolated kernel package containing that fix. The standalone dependency regression passed 7 test methods / 39 subcases without skips. Both sides use the original model configuration and weights. The observational run captures computed Q/K/V and learned sinks without rewriting them.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original FIA source at `b4822bae03589d0a127a0e5b1f06f0d28524f28b`, with the same kernel dependency | The real pretrained model fails during the original full-attention FIA path with the error below |
| Patched FIA prefill/eager decode source, real server, short and long prompts | Pass: 80/282 input tokens; each request generates 8 tokens with finite output token log probabilities |
| Actual pretrained prefill attention outputs from layer 0 (SWA128) and layer 1 (full attention), both prompts | All 46,336 observed token-heads pass; 0 precision failures; maximum relative L2 0.003780061955250345 (0.378%) under the fixed 1% gate |
| No-sink negative control, checked independently for each observed layer | All 4 captures reject the no-sink negative control, with 41,293 token-heads failing the unchanged precision gate in total |
| Registered server test, without the attention observer; more than one generated token per prompt | Pass: 1 registered test method / 2 HTTP subcases; 0 skips; exit code 0; each generates 8 tokens |
| Direct TND eager-decode operator numerical probe | 42 cases pass across D64/D128, contiguous and noncontiguous packed queries, paged KV, causal/full and SWA masks; independent sink/window/layout negative controls distinguish the incorrect paths |

The targeted prefill attention check uses actual pretrained Q/K/V and learned sinks, and compares the returned outputs against an independent CPU FP64 reference for every observed token/head. The fixed gate is relative L2 <= 1%, plus `sqrt(64) * 2^-134` for BF16 rounding, with finite values and exact expected-zero checks. The server runs the full 24-layer model; the real-model FP64 comparison observes only prefill outputs of layers 0 and 1. Eager decode is exercised by the multi-token server test; its operator-level numerical coverage is reported separately above. This is targeted attention correctness and server regression coverage, not a full task-quality benchmark.

The original and patched runs use the same isolated kernel dependency. The real-model runtime loaded the reviewed SwiGLU source before LF normalization; the published LF-only normalization has identical Python source after universal-newline decoding and also passed its standalone A3 regression.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This is a correctness fix. No throughput or latency improvement is claimed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- Documentation: no user-facing API change; the registered regression documents this behavior.
- Accuracy: actual single-A3 results above. Speed benchmarking is not applicable to this correctness fix; no performance claim.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

Please review the prefill dispatch and eager sink-decode layout changes and the new registered A3 regression. NPU CI needs the pinned 20B BF16 checkpoint in its cache and a kernel dependency that includes the SwiGLU fix above; these CI prerequisites still need maintainer confirmation. This PR is submitted as a draft for code review while those dependencies are arranged; local single-A3 validation above is complete.

+"""Real pretrained GPT-OSS prefill and eager decode with the Ascend FIA backend."""
+
+import hashlib
+import math
+import os
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import GPT_OSS_20B_BF16_WEIGHTS_PATH
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=400, suite="base-b-test-1-npu-a3")
+
+
+class TestGPTOSSFIAPrefill(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        # Genuine BF16 weights from unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-BF16, HF revision
+        # 5a6fe4c0c1a86147cb9dc1bb99486e61d12a3c9e. The ModelScope mirror
+        # has identical config, index and safetensors files.
+        cls.model = os.environ.get(
+            "SGLANG_TEST_GPT_OSS_20B_MODEL_PATH", GPT_OSS_20B_BF16_WEIGHTS_PATH
+        )
+        expected_metadata = {
+            "config.json": "1f2cdaf00d4c53dac6250cd435e31b3dafb7ce60b7dc5e7622ee292d57861975",
+            "model.safetensors.index.json": "bb72789eabdd4253264b146ad5a1f98d3ac215e214c942e563e756357e044f74",
+        }
+        for name, expected in expected_metadata.items():
+            actual = hashlib.sha256((Path(cls.model) / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+            if actual != expected:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected GPT-OSS checkpoint metadata: {name}")
+        cls.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
+            cls.model, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False
+        )
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            env={"ASCEND_USE_FIA": "1", "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE": "1"},
+            other_args=[
+                "--device",
+                "npu",
+                "--tp-size",
+                "1",
+                "--load-format",
+                "safetensors",
+                "--dtype",
+                "bfloat16",
+                "--attention-backend",
+                "ascend",
+                "--cuda-graph-backend-decode",
+                "disabled",
+                "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+                "disabled",
+                "--mem-fraction-static",
+                "0.90",
+                "--page-size",
+                "128",
+                "--max-total-tokens",
+                "2048",
+                "--max-running-requests",
+                "1",
+                "--context-length",
+                "512",
+                "--chunked-prefill-size",
+                "512",
+                "--disable-radix-cache",
+                "--disable-overlap-schedule",
+            ],
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_prefill_below_and_above_sliding_window(self):
+        # GPT-OSS alternates SWA128 and full-attention layers, both with D64
+        # learned sinks. Previously full prefill reached BSND with pre_tokens=-1
+        # and failed FIA parameter validation. Keep graphs off to isolate prefill.
+        # Generate multiple tokens to exercise the eager TND sink decode path too.
+        prompts = {
+            "short": "What is 17 plus 25? Answer in one sentence.",
+            "long": "Read this story carefully. "
+            + "Mira is a botanist. Each morning she checks the blue greenhouse, "
+            "waters three young trees, and records the weather in a notebook. "
+            "Her colleague Arun checks the red greenhouse and cleans the tools. "
+            * 5
+            + "Which greenhouse does Mira check, and how many young trees does she water?",
+        }
+        for case, prompt in prompts.items():
+            with self.subTest(case=case):
+                input_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+                    [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+                    tokenize=True,
+                    return_dict=False,
+                    add_generation_prompt=True,
+                    reasoning_effort="low",
+                )
+                self.assertGreater(len(input_ids), 0)
+                self.assertLessEqual(len(input_ids), 504)
+                if case == "long":
+                    self.assertGreater(len(input_ids), 128)
+                else:
+                    self.assertLess(len(input_ids), 128)
+                response = requests.post(
+                    self.base_url + "/generate",
+                    json={
+                        "input_ids": input_ids,
+                        "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 8},
+                        "return_logprob": True,
+                    },
+                    timeout=240,
+                )
+                response.raise_for_status()
+                result = response.json()
+                self.assertIsInstance(result["text"], str)
+                meta = result["meta_info"]
+                self.assertEqual(meta["prompt_tokens"], len(input_ids))
+                self.assertGreater(meta["completion_tokens"], 1)
+                output_logprobs = meta["output_token_logprobs"]
+                self.assertEqual(len(output_logprobs), meta["completion_tokens"])
+                self.assertTrue(all(math.isfinite(item[0]) for item in output_logprobs))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
